question: Do I need a building permit for my deck or fence?
answer: In Woodstock, fences generally do not require a permit unless they are enclosing a swimming pool. Decks typically require a permit if they are higher than 24 inches off the ground or attached to the house. We handle the entire permit application process for you — including all drawings and submissions to the City of Woodstock building department.

question: How deep do you dig your post holes?
answer: To beat the Ontario frost heave, we dig a minimum of 4 feet deep on every project — decks and fences alike. This puts the footing below the frost line, preventing your fence or deck from leaning or shifting during the winter freeze-thaw cycles. Posts are set in concrete and properly braced before the concrete cures.

question: How long does a typical installation take?
answer: Most residential fence projects are completed in 2 to 3 days (Day 1 for digging and setting posts in concrete, Day 2-3 for panel installation). Decks typically take 1 to 2 weeks depending on size, height, and material — composite and cedar decks take a little longer than pressure-treated due to fastener choice and finishing details.

question: Do you call before you dig?
answer: Yes — by Ontario law, underground utility lines must be marked before any excavation. We coordinate with Ontario One Call (1-800-400-2255) to ensure all gas, water, hydro, and telecom lines are clearly located and marked before any machinery touches your property. This is included in every quote at no extra cost.

question: What is the best deck material for Woodstock weather?
answer: All three of our deck materials work well in Ontario, with different tradeoffs. Pressure-treated is the most affordable and lasts 15-20 years with annual staining. Western Red Cedar is naturally rot-resistant and ages beautifully — about 20-25 years with proper care. Composite (Trex/TimberTech) is the longest-lasting choice with 25-30+ year manufacturer warranties and zero maintenance — most popular for homeowners who want to stop staining.

question: What is the best fence material for privacy?
answer: For pure privacy with no maintenance, vinyl is the top choice — tongue-and-groove panels with no gaps, never needs paint or stain, and looks new for 30+ years. For a natural wood look, board-on-board pressure-treated or cedar fencing is excellent and can be stained any colour. We typically recommend vinyl when budget allows, since the lifetime cost is lower despite the higher upfront price.

question: Do you offer a warranty on your work?
answer: Yes — we provide a 5-year workmanship warranty on all installations, covering structural defects, loose railings, settling posts, and any issues caused by our build. This is in addition to the manufacturer warranties on materials like composite decking (25-30 years) and vinyl fencing (lifetime limited).

question: How much does a typical deck or fence cost?
answer: Costs vary widely with size, material, and complexity. A standard 12×16 pressure-treated deck typically runs $7,000-$12,000; the same deck in composite is $14,000-$22,000. A 100 ft run of vinyl privacy fence usually lands between $6,000-$10,000. We provide free on-site quotes with written, itemized pricing so you know exactly what you're paying before we start — no surprises.

question: Can you remove and dispose of my old deck or fence?
answer: Yes. We handle full removal and disposal of existing decks and fences as part of any replacement project. Demolition is itemized separately on your quote so you can see exactly what it costs. We leave the site clean and ready for the new build.

question: Do you build pool fences?
answer: Yes — and we follow Ontario's pool fence regulations to the letter. That means minimum 4-ft height, self-closing and self-latching gates that open outward from the pool, no climbable horizontals on the outside, and proper gap spacing. We can build pool-compliant fences in vinyl, decorative steel, chain-link, or wood. We also handle the pool fence inspection coordination if required.

question: What areas do you serve?
answer: We serve Woodstock and all of Oxford County — including Ingersoll, Tillsonburg, Norwich, Embro, Thamesford, Innerkip, and surrounding communities. Travel within our service area is included in your quote with no hidden trip charges.

question: Can I get a free quote?
answer: Absolutely — every quote is free and on-site. We come to your property, measure, talk through material options, look at slope and drainage, and email you a detailed written quote within 48 hours. No deposit, no obligation. The best time to book is early spring through fall, since our schedule fills up quickly in peak season.
